content:
Your verification task is t9 (the old t5 seed is superseded — I created t9 with the full brief, so claim t9 and ignore t5). It is assigned to you and nearly unblocked: t1/t2/t3/t4/t6/t7 are all completed and I have spot-checked each one myself; only t8 (a render.js floor-pose fix) is still running.

Start now on everything that does not depend on t8, then re-run the visual checks once t8 lands.

Read the t9 description in full before touching anything — it defines what done means for each of the user's six requirements, lists the tools already in the repo that you must reuse instead of writing your own, and records two traps that have already produced false passes in this project (wall-clock bot runs prove nothing under headless swiftshader; and some tools were once silently pointed at the deployed old build instead of local).

You are read-only. VERIFY.md is the only file you may create. Be blunt — a report that says everything is fine without literal probe values and file:line evidence is worse than useless here.

t8 has landed — every task t9 depends on (t1, t2, t3, t4, t6, t7, t8) is now completed. Nothing is blocking you; run the full pass now.

Two things t8 changed that your report should reflect:
1. Resting coins and props no longer sink into the floor. The landed coin pose is now rotation.set(0, faz*0.35, 0) at FLOOR_Y + COIN_R*0.21, and landed props stand upright. `window.R.debugFall()` now returns rotation and prop-pose readouts, so you can confirm a landed pose numerically rather than by eyeballing a screenshot — please do that, since my earlier eyeball check on this exact defect is what missed it the first time.
2. The camera fit changed (desktop dist 2.174 → 2.087, band factor 1.06 added to FIT_POINTS). Re-run viewprobe yourself; do not take their numbers.

Also note for requirement 4: the museum now has TWO tabs (藏品 / 故事線), so a check that only looks at the grid is incomplete — verify the detail page still opens from the 藏品 tab and that the 故事線 tab reports the story rows (1 unlocked / 6 locked early in a fresh save).

Report to VERIFY.md only. Be blunt.
